title: Blackhole Menu
description: This modpack adds nothing except the fancy menu mod fully configured for a black hole look
body:
![Main title screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e205124415800675814079e2550e310f8df29534.png)

[![kinetic hosting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f3e5234712d32562be999b307b425ca6286f4b8e_0.webp)](https://billing.kinetichosting.com/aff.php?aff=1433)

This Modpack is very simple, it changes the look all minecraft menu's to a black hole themed menu with fancy menu's by kecksuccino. Be aware i didnt make this mod, i just made the template.
This modpack doenst add anything else besides this. You can add other mods on your own but this is purily just the menu screens and loading screens that were changed
